arguments.where_clause: transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND amount_usd_cents > 20000 AND card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND u.credit_score < 650)
arguments.explanation: Flags online transactions over $200 made on credit cards (not debit or prepaid) whose owner's credit score is below 650.
assumptions: 'Over $200' means strictly greater than $200, i.e. amount_usd_cents > 20000.
'Credit cards' means card_type = 'Credit' only; 'Debit (Prepaid)' and 'Debit' are excluded.
The owner's credit score is taken from users.credit_score via cards.user_id.
Negative amounts are excluded automatically because they are not above $200.
